Subject: Post-discovery: brief, calendar alignment & stakeholder pairings (Orbitrix)

Hi Samir / Lina — thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we stay momentum-focused: 

Recap (very high level):
- Goal: speed up triage and post-op documentation with an LLM-based assistant embedded in Orbitrix workflows
- Primary success criteria you shared: 1) reduce clinician documentation time by ~25%, 2) keep latency <250ms for in-line suggestions, 3) strict PHI separation / VPC deployment for pilot
- Key stakeholders to involve next: Product lead (Lina you mentioned), Security (Samir - please advise which person to include), and an engineering/infra owner for rollout questions

Proposed next step: 30-minute product brief + technical Q&A (we'll bring a PM and an infra engineer). I know calendars are tight — three compact windows below (all PT):
- Option A: Wed Dec 6, 10:30–11:00 PT (best for early west-coast attendees)
- Option B: Thu Dec 7, 13:00–13:30 PT (midday — good for East Coast + India overlaps)
- Option C: Fri Dec 8, 09:00–09:30 PT (short slot to keep it focused)

Ask: please pick one option and confirm the two Orbitrix stakeholders who should join (product + security or product + infra). We can adjust if none of these fit — I included a one-click calendar link below.

Attachments: discovery-notes-orbitrix.pdf (raw notes from today's call), redwood-one-pager.pdf

Calendaring: https://cal.example.com/chloe/redwood-30m
HubSpot ref: HS-12345678

Thanks — I’ll block provisional time once you confirm a slot.

—Chloe
